items.title: Disney (DIS) Names its First Technology Chief. Can AI Investment Deliver Returns?
items.summary: On September 18, 2026, Reuters reported that The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) named Karandeep Anand, the outgoing CEO of generative AI chatbot service Character.AI, as its first-ever chief technology officer, effective October 2.
